name: Grilled chicken
summary: Hill chicken grilled on the Thái fire with roasted mắc khén, chili, garlic, ginger, and salt.
origin: Báo Sơn La, 1 April 2022 and 4 September 2020.
howToEat: From the grill, with the rice. Wet chẩm chéo, on 16 July 2026, is also the dip for boiled chicken.
where: The Thái table. Cổng thông tin xã Hua La names grilled chicken with the Bản Mòng meal.
seoTitle: Ga nuong in Son La — grilled chicken on the Thai fire
seoDescription: Gà nướng in Sơn La, named by Báo Sơn La with pa pỉnh tộp and cơm lam.
